pattern_explanation: Polish and English share many words from the same Latin roots, but over time some of them drifted to different meanings in each language, so a close spelling does not guarantee the same sense.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Polish word aktualnie looks like the English word 'actually', but it means 'currently' or 'at the moment', while 'actually' means 'in fact' or 'really', so learners who trust the resemblance will misuse it.
